text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=queue-consumer-prod - symptom=queue_depth_exceeded threshold=10000 current=120384. Autoscaler not scaling (errors).

PD Bot: PagerDuty incident INC-2024-98765 triggered, urgency=high. Paging on-call.

Sasha (oncall): acked. I’m on it. first check on health/dashboard and if autoscaler events exist.

Alex M: saw the spike in the dashboard — 99th pct latency for inference-gateway up to 5.2s, error rate to 5.8% (5xx). Looks like backlog feeding downstream consumers.

Sasha (oncall): rolling through alerts: autoscaler controller shows repeated provisioning failures. suspected quota/spot eviction. Pulling controller logs now.

Devon: FYI I'm on infra rotation, will watch for node provisioning/ASG issues. If cloud quota, we need manual capacity request.

Maria SRE: tagging in. Can you paste the autoscaler controller logs? also any k8s events for the deployment?

Alex M: paste of recent logs:

```
E0423 21:03:12.456 controller.go:221] failed to create node: capacity-alloc quotaExceeded: requested=8 available=0
W0423 21:03:14.012 scale.go:88] backoff: scaling suppressed for group queue-consumer-pool: last_error=quotaExceeded
E0423 21:03:15.127 controller.go:303] reconcile failed: timed out waiting for resources
```

Sasha (oncall): That matches what I saw in cloud console — quota metric hitting 0 for GPUs in region us-west-2. However, there are also a bunch of Pending Pods with message "Insufficient cpus". Might be a mixed problem.

Devon: opening a limited capacity override request with cloud team now. Also checking if we can fallback to a smaller model flavor to reduce resource demand.

PD Bot: INC-2024-98765 acknowledged by Sasha (oncall). Escalation to Level2 in 5m if not resolved.

Maria SRE: quick customer-impact rundown for support/CS: Hosted API ingest queue is backing up; about 12% of requests are returning 5xx or timing out; mean latency for text-generation routes up from 150ms -> 1.2s, p95 ~5s. Potentially visible to paying customers hitting high throughput endpoints.

Sasha (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) try manual scale-up of worker pool to relieve queue (if cloud allows). 2) switch traffic route for lower-tier customers to fallback model instance with smaller resource profile. 3) if nodes not allocatable, enable degraded mode (reject new long-running requests with 429 + Retry-After).

Alex M: I can cut routing rule for non-enterprise keys to fallback model. Preparing a quick route change — will hold for handoff.

Devon: cloud override request submitted (REQ-5589). ETA from cloud on quota bump ~20-30m (they may prioritize). Request included temporary GPU borrowing from partner pool.

incident-bot: automatic notifier — canaries failing, rollout paused on queue-consumer-deploy-2024-04-23.

Maria SRE: quick test commands I ran to list pending pods and events:

```
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep Pending
kubectl describe pod queue-consumer-xxx -n inference | tail -n 40
kubectl get events -n inference --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -n 50
```

Alex M: manual routing change done for non-paid keys: switched route -> queue-consumer-small. Observing immediate reduction in new queue inflow by ~30%.

Sasha (oncall): good. that should buy us time. Maria, can you attempt a manual scale by increasing replicas to 60 and set a short PodDisruptionBudget? only if cloud allows.

Maria SRE: attempting manual scale now:

```
kubectl scale deployment/queue-consumer -n inference --replicas=60
# applying temporary tolerations to accept smaller nodes
kubectl patch deployment queue-consumer -n inference --patch 'spec: { template: { spec: { tolerations: [{ key: "dedicated", operator: "Exists" }] } } }'
```

Maria SRE: scale command accepted by k8s api, but pods stuck in Pending due to Insufficient resources. Cloud still shows GPU quota=0.

Devon: cloud update: partner pool loaned 4 nodes, provisioning now, should be ready in ~6m. Pushing for more.

Sasha (oncall): note for handoff: if partner pool doesn't arrive, plan B is to enable degraded mode and keep enterprise customers on dedicated reserved capacity (pin routing). I'm going to set a reminder to escalate to oncall-leads in 15m if no resolution.

PD Bot: Level2 escalation - notified Maria SRE and Alex M. Inc status: Investigating -> Mitigating.

Alex M: running quick health check script to see how many requests were retried vs failed in last 10m:

```
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?m=error_count%5B10m%5D&service=api-gateway" | jq .
# result: errors=1243, timeouts=872, retries=413
```

Sasha (oncall): customer impact note for opslog: high-priority customers on Dedicated Dedicated-1 unaffected, but shared-hosted customers seeing latency and intermittent 5xx. CS notified, posting incident summary to #customer-impact.

Maria SRE: partner nodes are showing Ready. Starting node join + scheduling. Pods are transitioning to ContainerCreating.

Alex M: seeing backlog drop from 120k -> 80k after initial pods started. Error rate down to 2.1%. Good signal.

Sasha (oncall): PD Bot: acknowledging handoff — I'm going to hand to Maria at 21:20 UTC for follow-through while I coordinate with CS.

PD Bot: Incident assigned to Maria SRE. Handoff note: Sasha (oncall) -> Maria SRE at 21:20 UTC.

Maria SRE: taking over. Next steps: monitor queue drain, watch autoscaler controller logs for recovery, file post-incident action: investigate quota alerting and fallback automation so autoscaler can fallback to spot/partner pool automatically.

Devon: filing follow-up infra ticket: INFRA-2043 (auto-borrow capacity & quota alerting). Also propose an autoscaler fail-open mode that can route low-priority traffic to smaller instance types.

Sasha (oncall): updating incident summary for PD and #incidents: root cause suspected immediate: cloud GPU quota exhaustion, contributing: autoscaler suppression/backoff and absence of automatic partner-pool fallback. Impact: ~12% errors for hosted customers, increased latency p95 to 5s, partial mitigation via route fallback and partner nodes.

Maria SRE: current metrics as of 21:35 UTC: queue depth 22k, error rate 0.9%, p95 latency 700ms. Continuing to watch.

Sasha (oncall): PD Bot: marking incident as "Mitigated". Will keep incident open until queue fully drained and autoscaler back to normal.

PD Bot: Incident INC-2024-98765 status updated -> Mitigated.

Devon: note for postmortem: add runbook step to circuit-break heavy customers when queue_depth > X and autoscaler suppressed. Also add alert for consecutive provisioning failures > 3 to auto-escalate to infra sooner.

Maria SRE: agreed. Creating postmortem draft and will include logs/snippets above and timeline. I'll ping oncall-leads for review.

Sasha (oncall): handing off officially. thanks team. I'll remain reachable for questions. :thumbsup:

Maria SRE: thanks — keeping thread updates.

PD Bot: Incident INC-2024-98765 will auto-resolve after 2h of no regressions or can be manually closed by assignee.

incident-bot: reminder to fill in customer-impact template in the PD incident and notify support reps.

Maria SRE: filing the customer-impact note now and linking to this thread.

(End of thread)
